items.headline: Purdie throws 3 TD passes as Liberty rolls past Ball State 51-15
items.description: — Deshawn Purdie threw three touchdown passes to lead Liberty to a 51-15 victory over Ball State on Saturday.

items.headline: Henderson, Copeland connect for winning TD as Liberty survives Gardner Webb 24-23
items.description: — Jaylen Henderson connected with Darius Copeland for a 54-yard touchdown with 2:34 remaining as Liberty survived FCS opponent Gardner-Webb 24-23 on Saturday for the Flames' first win since Nov. 1, 2025.

items.headline: James Madison begins the coach Billy Napier era with a 20-13 victory over in-state foe Liberty
items.description: — JC Evans threw for a touchdown and ran for a key first down late in the fourth quarter to help James Madison begin the coach Billy Napier era with a 20-13 victory over in-state foe Liberty on Saturday.
